# Sixtall

> Sixtall is a Cannabis delivery service serving customers across the United States. Same-night cannabis home delivery across Toronto and the GTA. Per-gram pricing on every product, one-tap reorder, e-Transfer, card or cash. Order by 9pm, we knock by 10. 19+.
